system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: msp_verify_otp and msp_check_procurement_status.. my aadhaar_number is 100020007997, my procurement_token is dummy_procurement_token_2281, my otp is dummy_otp_1879.

function.name: msp_check_procurement_status
function.description: Returns current procurement_status ('not_declared' through 'payment_processed') with details. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify status. Fails if token is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: msp_verify_otp
function.description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT register farmer or check MSP rates. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.
